from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

doc = Document()

sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.8)
sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.8)
st = doc.styles["Normal"]; st.font.name = "Calibri"; st.font.size = Pt(10.5)

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def para(text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, space_after=4):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    r = p.add_run(text); r.bold = bold; r.italic = italic
    if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    if align: p.alignment = align
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    return p

def rich(parts, style=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    for t, b in parts:
        r = p.add_run(t); r.bold = b
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def bullet(text, boldlead=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet")
    if boldlead:
        r = p.add_run(boldlead); r.bold = True
    p.add_run(text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, fs=9, hdr="1F3864", colorcol=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers)); t.style = "Table Grid"
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(fs); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
        shade(c, hdr)
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            r = cells[i].paragraphs[0].add_run(str(v)); r.font.size = Pt(fs)
            if colorcol is not None and i == colorcol:
                r.bold = True
                key = str(v).split()[0].upper() if str(v) else ""
                col = {"CRITICAL":"F4B6B6","HIGH":"F8CBAD","MEDIUM":"FFE699","LOW":"E2EFDA","DISCREPANCY":"F4B6B6","VARIANCE":"FFE699","MATCH":"E2EFDA","NOTE":"DDEBF7","VERIFY":"FFE699"}.get(key.strip(":;,"))
                if col: shade(cells[i], col)
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def finding(fid, title, sev, sources, detail, impact, action):
    doc.add_heading(f"{fid}  {title}", level=3)
    t = doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2); t.style = "Table Grid"
    for k, v in [("Severity", sev), ("Sources", sources), ("Finding", detail), ("Impact / Risk", impact), ("Recommended Action", action)]:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = ""; r = cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run(k); r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(9)
        shade(cells[0], "D9E2F3")
        cells[1].text = ""; r2 = cells[1].paragraphs[0].add_run(v); r2.font.size = Pt(9)
        if k == "Severity":
            r2.bold = True
            shade(cells[1], {"CRITICAL":"F4B6B6","HIGH":"F8CBAD","MEDIUM":"FFE699","LOW":"E2EFDA"}[v.split()[0]])
    for row in t.rows:
        row.cells[0].width = Inches(1.4); row.cells[1].width = Inches(5.5)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)

finding("B-1", "Asylum Program Fee ($600) omitted from the filing", "CRITICAL",
 "Cover Letter § IV ($715 + $2,805 = $3,520.00); Checklist Item 5 and Fee Summary tab (check for $3,520.00); I-797C ($715.00 received); Cover Letter § II (approximately 340 employees; FY 2024 revenue about $87 million)",
 "Under the USCIS fee schedule final rule (89 Fed. Reg. 6194 (Jan. 31, 2024), effective April 1, 2024; 8 C.F.R. § 106.2(c)(13)), every Form I-140 must be filed with an Asylum Program Fee. The fee is $600 for most employers, $300 for small employers with 25 or fewer full-time-equivalent employees, and $0 for nonprofits. Helion is a for-profit company with about 340 employees, so it owed the full $600. The correct total payment was $715 (I-140) + $600 (APF) + $2,805 (I-907) = $4,120.00. The firm paid $3,520.00, which is $600 short. Neither the cover letter, the checklist nor the Fee Summary mentions the APF at all, which points to an outdated firm fee template.",
 "A benefit request filed without the correct fee is subject to rejection (8 C.F.R. § 103.2(a)(7)(ii)). A rejected filing keeps no receipt date or priority date. USCIS has issued a receipt notice, but that does not prevent later rejection or a fee-related denial. If the petition is rejected, the March 17, 2025 priority date is lost, a refiling would carry a later priority date, and the premium processing and adjudication timeline would restart. This is the most serious risk in the file.",
 "(1) Escalate to the responsible partner today. (2) Confirm the amount USCIS actually deposited (see A-5). (3) Prepare a complete contingency refiling package now: current-edition I-140, I-907, G-28, separate payments of $715, $600 and $2,805, and the full evidence set. That way, if USCIS rejects the petition, the case can be refiled the same day. (4) Tell the Petitioner about the error and the contingency plan, and follow the firm’s risk-management and notification procedures. (5) Watch the mail and USCIS account for any rejection, fee notice or RFE, and respond immediately. (6) Update the firm’s I-140 fee template (see B-2).")
